text.tspan: Tested: what happens to each field on helm upgrade (Helm 4.2.3, Kubernetes 1.34)
The 3 rules of the 3-way merge: (1) NEW ≠ LIVE → set it to NEW. (2) In OLD but not in NEW → delete it, at the level where OLD and NEW differ. (3) Only in LIVE → leave it alone.
Server-side apply uses per-field owners instead of OLD, so it deletes only fields Helm alone owned. --force-replace overwrites the object with NEW, so every hand-made change is lost.
Green = someone else's change survived · Blue = the chart's intent applied · Orange / red = someone else's change was lost
